angle: Implementation-only refactor of a widely-called method on the root CRD type
difficulty_notes: GetConfigSection is called (directly or via GetConfigSectionValue) in three files that span two critical subsystems: the auth client and the Grafana deployment reconcilers. Models that anchor on 'this method is called by 3 files in core subsystems' will hallucinate compile-breaks in controllers/client/auth.go, controllers/reconcilers/grafana/service_reconciler.go, and controllers/reconcilers/grafana/admin_secret_reconciler.go. The trap: the method signature is byte-for-byte identical before and after. Only the internal nil-guard logic is restructured. The callers never see any change in the compiled interface or the return values.
